nodes.label: WebSocket-Aware Promptfoo Security Pentest
nodes.description: Proposed red-team harness sends adversarial input over the public HTTP sink, reconstructs NPC output from WebSocket stream frames, and validates post-turn state through read endpoints.

nodes.label: Promptfoo Security Taxonomy and Gates
nodes.description: Separate injection, exfiltration, jailbreak, state-abuse, and robustness suites use weighted severity, state invariants, a critical-only PR gate, and repeated nightly scans.

nodes.label: Debug Snapshot Disclosure Baseline
nodes.description: The unauthenticated debug snapshot is treated as a known fingerprinting disclosure; only model/provider/config information recoverable beyond that baseline counts as a new critical leak.

edges.description: The suite taxonomy and CI thresholds define how the pentest runs continuously.
A known disclosure baseline makes new exfiltration findings measurable rather than treating all debug output equally.
The two plans share Promptfoo wiring but intentionally separate security and quality corpora.
